prompt: The emitter writes a 12-byte header, a segment table, then text bytes, then data bytes. Segment 0 is text (flags R+X = 5). Segment 1 (flags R+W = 6) exists only when the memory size of the data area is above zero.

explain: No data and no bss means MemSize is 0, so only the text segment is written. R+X is 4 + 1 = 5 and R+W is 4 + 2 = 6. Executing from a writable data segment would break W^X, so the entry must be inside text.
